operation.description: Lists payments, newest first. By default, returns sales for the accounts your credential can read: an account credential's own account, or every account a user can read payments for. Set `mode` to `user_sales` to list the sales the signed-in user received personally, outside any account. With a user credential, set `user_id` to `me` to list the user's own payments, including their purchases from any account; a purchase leaves out the account's side of the payment, such as `amount_after_fees`, `metadata` and the risk fields.

parameters.description: Which sales to list. `account_sales` returns sales for the accounts the caller can read, and with `user_id=me` the user's own purchases too. `user_sales` returns only sales the signed-in user received personally, outside any account; it requires the user's own Whop login session and cannot be combined with `account_id`.
parameters.name: mode

parameters.description: Only payments charged by this account, prefixed `biz_`. With `user_id=me`, an account whose payments you cannot read lists only your own purchases from it.
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.description: Only payments in this lifecycle state.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Only payments whose most recently attached kept shipment is in this tracking state. `missing_tracking` selects paid payments with a captured shipping address and no kept shipment, excluding fully refunded payments. `needs_tracking` selects payments with an open pre-shipment funds hold and no kept shipment. Shipment states do not imply a payment or refund state. Requires `shipment:basic:read` as well as `payment:basic:read`; user-wide lists include only accounts readable under both scopes, and none of the user's purchases. Only supported with `mode=account_sales`.
parameters.name: tracking_status

parameters.description: Only payments charged for this reason. `subscription_cycle` also matches renewals recorded as `subscription_update`.
parameters.name: billing_reason

parameters.description: Only payments presented in this three-letter currency, such as `usd`.
parameters.name: currency

parameters.description: Only payments made by this buyer, prefixed `user_`. `me` is the signed-in user and needs a user credential: a whop.com session, an OAuth token or a user-scoped token. It lists the user's own payments: their purchases from any account, and their payments on accounts they read as the seller.
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description: Search payments by payment ID, dispute ID, user ID, membership ID, user email, name, or username. Email filtering requires the member:email:read permission.
parameters.name: query

schema.description: Search payments by payment ID, dispute ID, user ID, membership ID, user email, name, or username. Email filtering requires the member:email:read permission.

parameters.description: Also cover the account's subaccounts. Requires `account_id`, and is a 400 without it. Without `query`, lists the payments of the account and every subaccount, newest first by `created_at` only; another `order` is a 400. The listing is cut off after 10 seconds, which a rare filter on an account with little recent activity can reach; add a `query` to narrow it. With `query`, matches on payment, dispute, user or membership ID, buyer email, or a card's first 6 or 8 digits and last 4 separated by a space or dash (`424242 4242`); free-text queries such as a name search only the named account. Subaccounts' payments are returned only for subaccounts you can read payments on.
parameters.name: include_subaccounts

parameters.description: Only payments made by this member, prefixed `mber_`.
parameters.name: member_id

parameters.description: Only payments billed under this membership, prefixed `mem_`.
parameters.name: membership_id

parameters.description: Only payments for this product, prefixed `prod_`.
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.description: Only payments priced by this variant, prefixed `plan_`.
parameters.name: variant_id

parameters.description: Only payments created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: created_before

parameters.description: Only payments created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: created_after

parameters.description: Only payments in any of these lifecycle states, with the same meanings as `status`. Repeat the parameter to pass several. Combined with `status` when both are sent.
parameters.name: statuses

parameters.description: Only payments whose `substatus` is any of these. Repeat the parameter to pass several. `incomplete` also matches payments that report `incomplete` because no finer status was recorded. A purchase Whop's risk checks blocked reports `failed`, so `failed` matches it and `blocked` does not.
parameters.name: substatuses

parameters.description: Only payments charged for any of these reasons, with the same meanings as `billing_reason`. Repeat the parameter to pass several. Combined with `billing_reason` when both are sent.
parameters.name: billing_reasons

parameters.description: Only payments presented in any of these three-letter currencies. Repeat the parameter to pass several. Combined with `currency` when both are sent.
parameters.name: currencies

parameters.description: Only payments charged at least this amount: what the buyer was charged after discounts and including tax, in the currency each payment was presented in, the same amount `order=amount` sorts by. Where tax is added on top of the price (`tax_behavior` is `exclusive`), that is the price plus the tax, so a 995 price with tax added does not match `995`: match a range instead. A failed payment that charged nothing matches 0, not its price. Inclusive and compared to the cent. Pair it with `currencies` when the account sells in several. Send the same value as `max_amount` to match one exact amount.
parameters.name: min_amount

parameters.description: Only payments charged at most this amount, measured like `min_amount`: after discounts and including tax, in the currency each payment was presented in. Inclusive and compared to the cent. Must not be less than `min_amount`.
parameters.name: max_amount

parameters.description: Only payments priced by any of these variants, each prefixed `plan_`. Repeat the parameter to pass several. Combined with `variant_id` when both are sent.
parameters.name: variant_ids

parameters.description: Only payments for any of these products, each prefixed `prod_`. Repeat the parameter to pass several. Combined with `product_id` when both are sent.
parameters.name: product_ids

parameters.description: Only payments paid with any of these methods: a card brand such as `amex`, a wallet such as `apple_pay`, or a payment method type such as `paypal`. Repeat the parameter to pass several.
parameters.name: payment_methods

parameters.description: Only payments whose shipment is in any of these tracking states, or that still need a tracking number (`needs_tracking`). Repeat the parameter to pass several. Requires `account_id` and the shipment:basic:read permission.
parameters.name: tracking_states

parameters.description: Only payments refunded after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: refunded_after

parameters.description: Only payments refunded before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: refunded_before

parameters.description: Only payments with a dispute alert after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: dispute_alerted_after

parameters.description: Only payments with a dispute alert before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: dispute_alerted_before

parameters.description: Only payments with a dispute opened after this ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: dispute_created_after

parameters.description: Only payments with a dispute opened before this ISO 8601 timestamp.
parameters.name: dispute_created_before

parameters.description: The field to sort by. `amount` sorts by the amount charged, in the currency it was charged in. `status`, `product`, `plan` (initial price, no currency) and `method` are a 400 unless the list is filtered to 50,000 payments or fewer.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: The sort direction.
parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: Number of results to return from the start of the range.
parameters.name: first

parameters.description: Return results after this cursor. Use `page_info.end_cursor` from the previous response to fetch the next page.
parameters.name: after

parameters.description: Number of results to return from the end of the range.
parameters.name: last

parameters.description: Return results before this cursor. Use `page_info.start_cursor` from the previous response to fetch the previous page.
parameters.name: before

parameters.description: Set to `true` to return the number of matching results in `page_info.total_count`. Send `first=0` as well to return the count without any results.
parameters.name: include_total_count

total_count.description: Number of results matching the filters, across every page. Counting stops at 10,000. `null` when `include_total_count` isn't `true`, or when the count ran out of time.

total_count_capped.description: Whether counting stopped at the limit. `true` means `total_count` is 10,000 or more.

403.description: tracking filter without shipment read permission

account_id.description: The account that received the payment, prefixed `biz_`.

amount_after_fees.description: What the account keeps: the total less Whop's fees. Null when you read the payment as its buyer.

amount_charged.description: What the buyer is charged for this payment: the total plus any buyer fees, in the currency the buyer pays in. Refunds do not reduce it; `presentment_refunded_amount` states them in the same currency.

auto_capture_at.description: When Whop will capture this authorized card payment automatically unless it is voided first, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Null when no automatic capture was requested.

auto_refunded.description: True when Whop refunded the payment automatically, for example on a dispute alert.

billing_address.description: The billing address the buyer entered, or null.

billing_reason.description: Why the charge was created: a first purchase, a renewal, a one-time payment, or a manual charge.

capture_expires_at.description: When the hold on this authorized card payment expires if it is not captured first, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Null when the payment was not created for later capture.

checkout_configuration_id.description: The checkout configuration the buyer paid through, prefixed `ch_`, or null.

checkout_origin.description: The scheme and host of the website where the buyer opened the checkout, such as `https://store.example.com`. Use it to tell apart payments from different websites on one account. Null when the website was not recorded, including for payments made without the buyer present.

checkout_surface.description: The checkout experience that produced this payment, such as `embedded_checkout` for a checkout on the account's own website or `off_session` for a subscription renewal. Null when the checkout was not recorded.

client_secret.description: The credential a buyer's surface presents to poll this payment, set its return URL and resume it when the bank asked the customer to authenticate. Only on payments created from a confirmation token or waiting on that authentication, null when you read the payment as its buyer, and always null in list responses — retrieve the payment for it.

created_at.description: When the payment was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

currency.description: The currency the payment settles in, lowercase ISO 4217. Every money field below is stated in it unless it says otherwise.

customer_email.description: The buyer's email address. Null without `member:email:read` on the account or when the buyer has no assigned email.

customer_phone.description: The phone number the buyer gave at checkout, when one was collected.

decline_code.description: The normalized decline reason of the most recent failed attempt, or null.

dispute_alerted_at.description: When an issuer warned that this payment will be disputed, or null.

dispute_created_at.description: When the most recent dispute on this payment was opened, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Null when the payment was never disputed, or without the payment:dispute:read permission.

failure_message.description: Why the most recent attempt failed, in plain words, or null.

financing_installments_count.description: For installment methods, how many payments the charge splits into.

items.description: The active holds on this payment. Each hold has its own release date, independent of `settlement_time_at`. Empty when nothing is held or you read the payment as its buyer; released holds are omitted.

ip_address.description: IP address that Whop captured from the buyer's browser at checkout. Null when the buyer was not present at checkout, for example a subscription renewal or a charge made without the buyer. Also null when you read the payment as its buyer.

last_payment_attempt_at.description: When the most recent charge attempt ran, or null.

items.description: Everything this payment charged for, in purchase order, with quantities and subtotals in the purchase currency. Payments made before item snapshots were recorded return the single item implied by their variant. Empty when no items or variant can be resolved.

member_id.description: The buyer's member record on the account, prefixed `mber_`. Null without the member:basic:read permission, unless you are the buyer.

membership_id.description: The membership this payment is billed against, prefixed `mem_`. Null for one-off purchases, or without the member:basic:read permission unless you are the buyer.

metadata.description: Your own key-value data attached when the payment was created. Null when you read the payment as its buyer.

missing_tracking.description: True for a paid payment with a shipping address, no shipment, and no full refund. Null without the shipment:basic:read permission.

needs_tracking.description: True when funds are held until the order ships and no tracking number has been added yet. Null without the shipment:basic:read permission.

next_payment_attempt_at.description: When the next automatic retry is scheduled, or null.

paid_at.description: When the money was collected, or null while it has not been.

payment_instrument.description: The instrument shaped for display: a buyer-facing name, the standard icon set, and when it was a card, the card's brand, last four, issuer identification number, and the network transaction id the account uses for the card. The network transaction id is null when you read the payment as its buyer.

payment_method_id.description: The stored payment method that was charged, prefixed `payt_`. Null when the method was not saved.

payment_method_type.description: The kind of instrument used, for example `card`, `apple_pay`, `klarna`, or `us_bank_account`.

items.description: The account's own payment rules that decided this payment, recorded when they ran. Only one action is taken per payment, so a rule that matched but was skipped or outranked is not listed. Empty when none decided it, when the account had no rules, when Whop blocked the payment before they ran, or when you read the payment as its buyer.

payments_failed.description: How many charge attempts have failed on this payment.

presentment_refunded_amount.description: How much has been refunded so far, in the currency presented to the buyer. Zero when nothing has been refunded.

presentment_tax_amount.description: The sales tax or VAT collected, in the currency presented to the buyer. Null when no tax applied.

presentment_total.description: The account-facing total in the currency presented to the buyer, before conversion into the settlement currency. Excludes buyer fees.

product_id.description: The product the variant belongs to, prefixed `prod_`. Null for a variant with no product.

promo_code_id.description: The promo code applied at checkout, prefixed `promo_`, or null.

quote_id.description: The payment quote this payment charged, prefixed `pq_`: its purchase, promo code and `tax_amount` are the quote's. Null when the payment named no quote and tax was calculated at charge time.

recovery_url.description: Whop-hosted URL where the buyer can sign in and complete 3D Secure for an off-session charge the bank challenged — a subscription renewal or a saved-card payment. Null when recovery is unavailable, you lack `member:basic:read`, or in list responses. Retrieve the payment for it.

refundable.description: True when the payment is `paid`, not yet fully refunded, and its processor supports refunds.

refunded_amount.description: How much has been refunded so far, as it settled — refunds convert at the rate in force when each one was issued, not the payment's original rate.

refunded_at.description: When the payment was refunded, or null.

resolution_center_ineligible_reason.description: Why the buyer cannot open a Resolution Center case on this payment with `POST /resolution_center_cases`, or null when they can. `already_opened`: a case is already open or was decided (a withdrawn case does not count). `unsupported_payment_processor`: the payment method does not support cases. `out_of_date`: the window to open a case has passed. `not_paid`: the payment is not `paid`. `free`: nothing was charged. `already_refunded`: some of it has been refunded.

response_due_at.description: When the earliest response is due on a dispute or Resolution Center case awaiting the account's response, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Null when nothing awaits a response, or without the permission to read that dispute or case.

retryable.description: True when the payment can be retried by hand with `POST /payments/{id}/retry`. The payment must be `open` and not paid through an invoice payment link. Its membership must be `active`, `trialing`, or `past_due`, or the payment must be a failed first payment on a `drafted` membership. Its one manual retry must not be used up. A retry can still be refused when the account cannot currently accept payments.

risk_score.description: Whop's published risk index from 0 (lowest) to 100 (highest), including enforced decision floors. This is not a fraud probability. Null when no score is available or you read the payment as its buyer.

risk_signals.description:
Deprecated. Risk score explanations are no longer provided; always null.
DEPRECATED: Risk score explanations are no longer provided. Always null.

settlement_time_at.description: When the portion not listed in `holds` posts to the account's available balance, at midnight UTC. The `financial_activity.funds_available` webhook's `posted_at` carries the same value when the settlement that clears it posts. Null until the payment is paid or when you read the payment as its buyer, and always null in list responses — retrieve the payment for it.

shipment_id.description: The shipment fulfilling this payment, prefixed `ship_`. Null when nothing ships or without the shipment:basic:read permission.

shipping_address.description: The shipping address for physical goods, or null.

status.description: The lifecycle state of the charge: `open` while collection is outstanding, `paid` once the money moved, `pending` while a settlement rail clears, `void`/`uncollectible` when it ended without collecting.

substatus.description: The dashboard's finer-grained reading of the payment, folding in refunds, disputes and Resolution Center cases.

subtotal.description: The price before discounts, tax and fees.

surcharge.description: The card surcharge the buyer pays for paying by credit card. It is included in `total` and `amount_charged`, and appears in `line_items` as a line of its own. Null when the payment has no surcharge.

tax_amount.description: The sales tax or VAT collected. Null when no tax applied.

tax_behavior.description: Whether `tax_amount` was added on top of the price (`exclusive`) or was already inside it (`inclusive`).

tax_refunded_amount.description: How much of the collected tax has been returned to the buyer so far. Zero when the payment carried no tax, or when nothing has been refunded.

three_ds_verified.description: True when the buyer completed 3D Secure for this payment.

total.description: The account-facing total: the price after discounts, plus any tax added on top. Excludes buyer fees, which the buyer pays above this amount — so this is not necessarily what the buyer's statement shows; `amount_charged` is what the buyer is charged.

updated_at.description: When the payment last changed, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

usd_total.description: The total converted to USD at the time of the charge, for reporting across currencies. Excludes the adaptive pricing FX markup, which the account does not keep. Null when you read the payment as its buyer.

user.description: The buyer. Null when the buyer is an account rather than a user.

user_agent.description: The buyer's browser user agent at checkout. Null when the buyer was not present at checkout, such as a subscription renewal, or without the member:basic:read permission.

variant_id.description: The variant that was charged, prefixed `plan_`.

verification_checks.description: The Address Verification Service (AVS), cardholder name, and Card Verification Value (CVV/CVC) results, or null when the processor returned none or you read the payment as its buyer.

voidable.description: True when the payment can be voided or canceled. The request is rejected if the payment is no longer eligible — see `POST /payments/{id}/void`.

wuid.description: The Whop pixel's visitor ID for the buyer's browser at checkout, prefixed `wuid_`. Null when the checkout page had no Whop pixel, when the buyer was not present at checkout, or without the member:basic:read permission.

code.description: Machine-readable reason for this specific refusal, such as `bank_warning_not_acknowledged`. Only present when the error carries one.

amount.description: The amount in major units, as an exact decimal string. For example, `"10.00"` is ten dollars. It is a string so that no float rounds it in transit.

decimals.description: How many decimal places the amount carries. This is the precision the charge itself runs at.

display_decimals.description: How many decimal places to SHOW. Usually equal to `decimals`, and deliberately not always: COP is charged in centavos but written in whole pesos, so it is `2` and `0`. Format the number in your own locale using this.

BillingReasons.description: The reason why a specific payment was billed

Currencies.description: The available currencies on the platform

PaymentDeclineCodes.description: The reason a payment was declined.

amount.description: The amount currently held, in the hold's currency.

percentage.description: The reserve percentage recorded when the hold was created, for example 3.5 for 3.5%. Null for other hold types or when no percentage was recorded.

release_at.description: When the held funds are scheduled to become available, as an ISO 8601 timestamp. Never earlier than the payment's settlement date. Null when release depends on an event, such as shipment resolution, rather than a date.

type.description: The reason funds are held: `reserve`, `bnpl`, `sequra`, `fraud_hold`, or `preshipment_hold`.

id.description: Line item ID, prefixed `li_`. Null when the payment predates item snapshots and the item is read from the payment's variant.

label.description: The item's name as shown at checkout (the product title, else the variant title).

product_id.description: The product the variant belongs to, prefixed `prod_`. On a payment that predates item snapshots this falls back to the variant's product, so it can be set where the parent's own `product_id` is null. Null for a variant with no product.

product_title.description: The product's current title, or `null` when the item has no product.

sku.description: The variant's stock keeping unit, free text set by the seller (e.g. `TSHIRT-LARGE-BLUE`). Accounts with billing-reason SKU suffixes enabled receive it stamped with why the charge happened: `-S` for a first subscription charge, `-R` for a renewal, `-C` for a one-time purchase, `-U` when the payment's own metadata carries `upsell: true`, `-F` when nothing was charged. Other billing reasons carry the bare SKU. `null` when the variant has no SKU or has been deleted.

subtotal.description: The recorded amount for this item's full quantity, before discounts, tax, and fees, in its purchase currency. Returns `null` when no item amount was recorded.

variant_id.description: The variant bought, prefixed `plan_`. Null when the variant has since been deleted.

variant_title.description: The variant's current title, or `null` when the variant has been deleted or has no title.

card.description: Card, Apple Pay, and Google Pay payments only: the card's network, last four, issuer identification number, expiry, and network transaction id.

crypto.description: Crypto payments only: the on-chain transaction that the buyer sent.

display_name.description: Buyer-facing instrument name — "Visa •••• 4242" when the card surfaced, else the method's own name ("Klarna").

icons.description: The standard icon set: square and card shapes, each in light and dark colorways.

installment_count.description: Installment methods only: how many payments the charge splits into. Data, not copy — compose and translate the label client-side.

payment_method_type.description: The payment method type identifier, e.g. `card`, `klarna`, `apple_pay`.

PaymentMethodTypes.description: The different types of payment methods that can be used.

name.description: The rule's name when it matched. Renaming the rule afterwards does not rewrite this.

FriendlyReceiptStatus.description: The friendly status of a payment. This is a derived status that provides a human-readable summary of the payment state, combining the underlying status and substatus fields.

ReceiptTaxBehaviors.description: The type of tax inclusivity applied to the receipt, for determining whether the tax is included in the final price, or paid on top.

items.description: Public badges for the user, in display order. Empty when the user has no badges or is suspended.

profile_picture.description: Avatar wrapper. Its `url` is always present, and is a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.

address_line1.description: The Address Verification Service (AVS) result for the billing street address.

arn.description: The Acquirer Reference Number (ARN) that traces this charge through the card network, or null when the processor did not return one.

authorization_code.description: The card issuer's authorization code for this charge, or null when the processor did not return one.

card_holder_name.description: Whether the cardholder name matched the issuer's records.

zip_code.description: The Address Verification Service (AVS) result for the billing postal code.

brand.description: The network identifier (`visa`, `amex`, …), matching `card.networks` entries and saved card payment methods. Null when the vault did not record the network.

exp_month.description: The card's expiry month, 1 to 12. Null when the vault did not record it.

exp_year.description: The card's four-digit expiry year. Null when the vault did not record it.

issuer_identification_number.description: The issuer identification number, also called the BIN: the card's leading six or eight digits, which identify the issuing bank. Null when the processor did not report it.

last4.description: The card's last four digits, when captured.

network_transaction_id.description: The network transaction id this account uses for the card. It's this account's own id, from its first customer-present charge or verification on the card, when Whop has one. Otherwise it's an earlier network transaction id for this card, which can come from another account's transaction or be one brought with the card. Cite it as the prior transaction on a later merchant-initiated charge of this card at this account. Null until there is one. A webhook sent as a payment is first recorded can carry `null`, so retrieve the payment to read it.

transaction_hash.description: The hash of the on-chain transaction that the buyer sent to pay. Use it to find the payment from a hash that the buyer gives you. Null until the payment provider reports the transaction.

type.description: Badge category. `whop_team` identifies a Whop team member. `verified_partner` identifies a verified member of the Whop Partners program.

url.description: Avatar image URL. Always present. It is a generated placeholder when the user set no picture.

png_1x.description: Raster fallback at the shape's native size.

svg.description: The vector file. Prefer this everywhere SVG renders.
